rationale: Butyrate fermentation with co-catabolism of L-cysteine and L-serine to recover from arginine depletion. Nitrogen-limited growth at 0.80 /h supported by amino acid deamination. Carbon balance: 78 mmol in − 30.4 (growth) − 47.6 (fermentation products) = 0. Produces typical Anaerostipes end products.
